# freshdesk_comment (Resource)

A comment on a community forum topic.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) Body of the comment, in HTML.
- `topic_id` (Number) ID of the topic. Changing it forces a new comment.

### Optional

- `answer` (Boolean) Whether the comment is marked as the topic's answer.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user credited as the author.

### Read-Only

- `body_text` (String) Plain-text rendering of `body`.
- `created_at` (String) When the comment was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the comment.
- `updated_at` (String) When the comment was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_comment.example 42
```
